review tier.instructions: The state describes one pull request of the Imperial Conquest 2 build, a C# remake of a strategy game. It may open with a line 'PR kind: task', 'PR kind: fix' or 'PR kind: plan'. Then comes the contract the PR implements: a task entry (docs/tasks/T<nn>.md, with Owns, Scope, Done when, Model/effort and Reviewer fields), or a bug body for a fix, or a plan PR's description. It ends with the PR's `git diff --stat`. Choose how complex the PR's review is. Read the Owns list, the Scope, the Effort field and the file paths in the --stat. A task or fix PR is never simple. A plan PR is never very complex. Choose very complex when at least one of its criteria holds, complex when the PR changes code or a contract and no very-complex criterion holds, and simple only for a documentation PR that changes no contract.

criteria.simple: Documentation only, with no contract change: evidence-only doc claims (corrected facts in design-audit.md, game-design.md or docs/investigations/) or routine bookkeeping (folding a bug into a blocked task, a 'never in flight with' constraint, an Owns amendment that adds unclaimed paths, a merge-after on a merged task, the catalogue's stub, index row or graph edges to merged tasks). The --stat touches nothing under src/, tests/, godot/, scripts/, data/, .github/ or .opencode/, adds no task and changes no Scope, Done-when or dependency line, and does not edit build-process.md, operating-guide.md or CLAUDE.md.
criteria.complex: Any task or fix PR (it changes code, tests, data, scripts or workflows) that meets none of the very-complex criteria; or any plan PR that adds a task, changes a Scope, Done-when or dependency line, or edits a process document (build-process.md, operating-guide.md, CLAUDE.md, evidence-pipeline.md, milestone-review.md, release-plan.md). Typical: a new command or verb with its handler and tests, a UI screen, a data-file correction, a parser or validation fix, a rule implemented with given constants, a script change. A High-effort entry alone is still complex.
criteria.very complex: A task or fix PR with at least one of: (a) an architecture task (T02, T03, T16, T22) or an Ultrahigh effort; (b) a new subsystem: a new project, a new top-level folder under src/IC2.Engine/ or src/IC2.Data/, or a new turn-pipeline phase; (c) a save-format or serialization change: the save reader or writer, the JSON round-trip, a schema version, or a field added to a serialized model type; (d) it widens the shared domain model under src/IC2.Engine/Model/ that other tasks build on; (e) it changes a battle resolver's or the AI's outcomes under a seed and re-baselines existing seeded expectations (values in tests/fixtures/corpus.json, expected-corpus-outcomes.json, existing golden lines, a soak or seeded measurement) rather than only adding new ones; (f) a correction task whose entry says its evidence is still open; (g) size: the Owns list names more than 15 files, or the --stat shows more than 20 files or more than 1,500 changed lines outside tests/fixtures/.
